name: grokhack-forge
summary: Composer for Grok apps: turns an app idea into a working repo (archetype `chat`: Vite + Vercel AI SDK @ai-sdk/xai with streaming and tools; archetype `digest`: Python xai-sdk with structured output on a schedule) using parts from grokhack-index, with CI that makes a real api.x.ai request and a GitHub Pages deploy.

entrypoints.name: compose app
entrypoints.usage: workflow_dispatch inputs: idea, name, request_id → results/<request_id>.json

entrypoints.name: templates/chat, templates/digest
entrypoints.usage: app templates the composer fills in

outputs.name: app repo
outputs.description: src/ (chat) or app/ (digest), tests, scripts/e2e, PARTS.md, forge.json, AGENTS.md, llms.txt, schema-valid blocks.json, CI, Pages workflow

compatible_with.how: parts source: SDK package versions at indexed fork commits, default model, reference snippets
give the app's developer agent blockchain tools, or port tools into the app
typed data calls as Grok tools inside a chat app (Build with Blocks recipe 2)

env.name: XAI_API_KEY
env.purpose: generated apps' live e2e; without it the e2e checks api.x.ai rejects the unauthenticated call

env.name: XAI_MODEL
env.purpose: override the default model in digest apps

env.name: FORGE_TOKEN
env.purpose: repo secret; lets the Action create repos
